description: This file defines the LogNode interface, which represents a node in a logging chain for Android development. It specifies a method for printing log data, supporting chaining of multiple log handling components.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: Interface for log handler nodes that can output logs to various targets and implement chain of responsibility for logging.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to instruct the log node to output the provided log data, including priority, tag, message, and optional throwable.
